initial_retrieval.claim:
ICICI Lombard Health AdvantEdge Policy Wording Section 3.1
Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 24 months.
Inpatient hospitalization expenses are covered up to the sum insured.
initial_retrieval.source: ICICI Lombard Health AdvantEdge Policy Wording Section 3.1

initial_retrieval.claim: Initial waiting period of 30 days applies for any illness except accident. Pre-existing disease (PED) waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Specific named ailments carry a 24-month waiting period.
initial_retrieval.source: HDFC ERGO Optima Secure Policy Wording Section 4.2 (UIN: HDFHLIP21557V022021)
